name: io-ui
description: Io's client half (io.js): io-* attributes for named handlers and directives, automatic CSRF headers. Built into ../src/Io/UI/io.js and shipped with the PHP package.

scripts.check:bundle: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --outfile=dist/check.js --target=es2019 --log-level=warning && (cmp -s dist/check.js ../src/Io/UI/io.js && echo 'io.js is up to date' || (echo 'src/Io/UI/io.js is out of date. Run: composer build:ui' >&2; exit 1))
